briefing: Markets were quiet today with NASDAQ +0.6% and S&P 500 +0.3%, a neutral session with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand is only $189.29, well below the $500 threshold needed to responsibly fund a new position, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and waiting for a clearer setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears rather than being forced into weak setups. Today our available cash was below the minimum buy threshold, so holding it in reserve — instead of stretching into a marginal trade — protects the portfolio and keeps flexibility for a better entry point.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留在場邊的現金，待出現真正吸引的機會時才動用，而非勉強追入普通的交易。今日可動用現金低於買入門檻，保留現金而非勉強交易，有助保護組合並保留日後把握更佳入市時機的靈活性。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices posted modest gains today, with the NASDAQ slightly outpacing the S&P 500, suggesting mild risk appetite without any decisive catalyst. Trading stayed range-bound rather than trending, typical of a consolidation day after recent moves. No major news events stood out to explain the drift, pointing to routine, low-conviction trading.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現溫和，納指升0.6%，標普500升0.3%，市場情緒偏向中性，未見明顯催化劑帶動方向。走勢主要在區間內浮動，屬於近期升勢後的整固格局。今日並無重大新聞事件可解釋市況，反映交投氣氛偏向觀望。
